inputs.text: They’re making Terry Pheto the face of an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal, and that feels less like transparency than a carefully managed distraction. If everyone keeps steering attention toward one person, the real question is who benefits from keeping the institutions—and whatever they may be hiding—out of focus.
